verdict.rationale: Poke documents a public API for sending messages programmatically from apps, scripts, and automation tools, and services like GitHub or CI/CD can trigger it (poke-docs-1, poke-docs-2). Because Poke is conversational, sending a message can drive it, and a CLI exists for login and MCP/recipe management (poke-docs-6, poke-docs-16). However, the documented API surface appears limited to message sending, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any standard path (poke-probe-3). missing for 10: documented endpoints beyond message sending (e.g. reading responses, managing memory, integrations or tasks), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
